name: Tadah
description: Hand-roasted in the forests of Småland by Julia & Michael. Thoughtful sourcing, ethical producers, quiet perfection.
quote: A hidden gem you discover once and never stop talking about.

name: Drop Coffee
description: Stockholm roastery known for being open about what it pays farmers.
quote: Possibly the most transparent roastery on the planet.

name: Koppi
description: Nordic roasting pioneers and World Cup judges. Extremely precise, expressive light roasts.
quote: If you're chasing extraordinary terroir, this is where you find it.

name: Johan & Nyström
description: One of Scandinavia's most established specialty brands with wide origin selection and reliable quality.
quote: The reliable backbone of Scandinavian specialty. Consistent, accessible, always good.

name: Tim Wendelboe
description: The legend. World Barista Champion turned farmer-direct roaster. A pilgrimage destination for any coffee geek.
quote: Every coffee geek should try at least one Wendelboe pour-over in their life.

name: Kaffa
description: Oslo institution with deep direct trade relationships and a focus on clean, sweet filter profiles.
quote: Oslo's neighbourhood hero. Honest, clean, and absolutely dependable.

name: The Coffee Collective
description: Multiple World Barista Champions. Radical transparency: every bag shows the exact price paid to farmers.
quote: They show every farmer's name and payment on the bag. Revolutionary honesty.

name: April Coffee Roasters
description: World Brewers Cup champion Patrik Rolf's roastery. Obsessively light, focused, and brilliant.
quote: Patrik Rolf's pursuit of clarity in a cup is unmatched. Every bag is a lesson.

name: La Cabra
description: Beautiful packaging, even more beautiful cups. Precision roasting for the filter-obsessed.
quote: The most beautiful bags in specialty coffee, and the coffee lives up to them.

name: Good Life Coffee
description: Finland's leading specialty roaster. Transparent sourcing, strong direct trade ethos.
quote: Finland's finest. Their sourcing relationships run deeper than most.

name: The Barn
description: Berlin's most celebrated roastery. Extremely light, precise roasting that spotlights terroir above all.
quote: They take light roasting to its logical, stunning extreme.

name: Five Elephant
description: Famous for their cheesecake and their coffee equally. Approachable specialty with a warm community feel.
quote: Come for the cheesecake, stay for the coffee. Berlin's most welcoming specialty spot.

name: Bonanza Coffee
description: Transparent, direct-trade focused roastery with a dedicated following across Europe.
quote: Quietly excellent. Their Colombian lots are some of the best in Europe.

name: Square Mile Coffee
description: Founded by World Barista Champions. The benchmark for precision specialty roasting in the UK.
quote: The textbook example of great specialty roasting. Used in competitions worldwide.

name: Origin Coffee
description: Farm-to-cup roaster from Cornwall with genuine producer relationships across three continents.
quote: Cornwall-born but globally minded. Their direct trade is genuinely deep.

name: Bocca Coffee
description: Amsterdam institution with deep sustainability roots and remarkable sourcing transparency.
quote: Sustainability isn't a buzzword here. The whole company is built on it.

name: Friedhats
description: Ultra-light roasters pushing boundaries. Known for Nordic-style clarity with Dutch directness.
quote: They roast lighter than Scandinavia and somehow make it work perfectly.

name: Belleville Brûlerie
description: Paris's specialty pioneer, and one of the first to bring light roasts to a city that drank its coffee dark.
quote: They proved Paris could do specialty. The café is a pilgrimage for French coffee lovers.

name: Lomi Roasters
description: Housed in a converted train station, Lomi trained a generation of French baristas and sources with care.
quote: Where Parisian specialty was born. Their training programs changed French coffee culture.

name: Coutume Café
description: Elegant Parisian roastery merging French café culture with third-wave precision. Beautiful spaces, beautiful coffee.
quote: The most Parisian of specialty roasters. Elegant, refined and quietly excellent.

name: Reykjavík Roasters
description: Remote but world-class. Iceland's most loved specialty roastery ships their precision roasts globally.
quote: From the edge of the world, some of the world's finest filter coffee.

name: Gardelli Specialty Coffees
description: World Cup of Tasters champion. They buy exceptional small lots and are one of Italy's leading specialty roasters.
quote: The Italian who proved Italy could lead the specialty world, not just espresso.

name: Ditta Artigianale
description: Florence's specialty icon, bridging Italian espresso tradition with modern third-wave roasting.
quote: Where Italian coffee culture meets the third wave. Florence has never tasted better.

name: Nomad Coffee
description: Spain's most internationally celebrated roastery. Immaculate sourcing, precision roasting.
quote: Spain's flag-bearer for world-class specialty. Their Ethiopian lots are legendary.

name: Fábrica Coffee Roasters
description: Lisbon's specialty pioneer, with beautiful cafés and thoughtfully sourced beans.
quote: Lisbon's beating heart for specialty. The café is as stunning as the coffee.

name: Petra Roasting Co.
description: Istanbul's specialty vanguard. World-class roasting in a city with 500 years of coffee heritage.
quote: Where Ottoman coffee heritage meets third-wave precision. Istanbul's finest.

name: Kronotrop Coffee
description: Turkish roaster with many awards, and several Turkish Barista Champions on the team.
quote: Turkey's most decorated roastery. Competition-grade quality, every single bag.

name: Montag Coffee Roasters
description: Young, bold Istanbul roastery focused on single origins and meticulous profiling. Rising fast in the specialty world.
quote: The new wave of Turkish specialty. Bold choices, exceptional results.

name: %Arabica
description: One of the most famous specialty coffee brands in the world, with a minimal Kyoto style and careful sourcing.
quote: The coffee actually matches the aesthetic. That alone is extraordinary.

name: Light Up Coffee
description: Kichijoji gem beloved by Japan's specialty scene for delicate, expressive light roasting.
quote: Tokyo's best-kept secret. Regulars call it the finest cup in the city.

name: Glitch Coffee & Roasters
description: Jimbocho roastery devoted to light-roasted single origins, brewed cup by cup at the bar.
quote: Light roasts brewed one cup at a time. A must for filter lovers in Tokyo.

name: Onibus Coffee
description: Tokyo roaster behind the much-loved Nakameguro coffee stand by the train tracks, with clean, sweet single origins.
quote: Clean, sweet cups and a much-loved stand by the Nakameguro train tracks.

name: Fuglen Tokyo
description: The Oslo café's Tokyo home in Tomigaya, roasting Nordic-style light coffee for the city.
quote: A slice of Oslo in Tomigaya: Nordic light roasts and vintage Norwegian design.

name: Leaves Coffee Roasters
description: Small roastery in Honjo, Sumida, roasting bright single origins with great care.
quote: A small Sumida roastery that treats every single origin with real care.

name: Philocoffea
description: Tetsu Kasuya's roastery, home of the 4:6 method that won him the 2016 World Brewers Cup.
quote: Brew the 4:6 method at its source, from the World Brewers Cup champion.

name: Kurasu
description: Kyoto café and roastery that ships its beans, partner roasters' coffee and Japanese brewing gear worldwide.
quote: Kyoto in a parcel: their own beans, guest roasters and Japanese brewing gear, shipped worldwide.

name: Maruyama Coffee
description: Karuizawa specialty pioneer since 1991, known for travelling to origin to buy its coffee.
quote: Over three decades of travelling to origin, and a cornerstone of Japanese specialty coffee.

name: Unir
description: Kyoto roaster since 2006; co-founder Tomoko Yamamoto represented Japan at the 2019 World Barista Championship.
quote: Competition-level Kyoto roasting with a quiet, careful touch.

name: Koffee Mameya
description: Omotesando bean shop where baristas help you choose from carefully picked roasters, with a brew recipe for every bean.
quote: Like a sommelier for coffee: talk it through with the barista and take home a recipe.

name: Fritz Coffee Company
description: Seoul roastery and bakery known for its seal logo, retro Korean design and carefully sourced single origins.
quote: Retro Korean design, fresh bread and serious coffee under one roof.

name: Momos Coffee
description: Busan roastery whose head barista Jeon Jooyeon became the first Korean World Barista Champion in 2019.
quote: Home of Korea's first World Barista Champion. Busan is worth the trip.

name: Coffee Libre
description: One of Korea's specialty pioneers, known for direct sourcing and boldly designed bags.
quote: One of the roasters that started Korea's specialty scene, and still one of its boldest.

name: Anthracite Coffee
description: Seoul roaster whose first café opened in a former shoe factory in Hapjeong.
quote: From a former shoe factory to a Seoul coffee landmark.

name: Namusairo
description: Long-standing Seoul specialty roaster with a hanok café in Seochon, roasting for clarity and sweetness.
quote: Quiet hanok mornings in Seochon and cups built on clarity and sweetness.

name: Terarosa
description: Gangneung roaster that helped make the city Korea's coffee town, with a sprawling roastery café.
quote: One of the reasons Gangneung became Korea's coffee city.

name: Center Coffee
description: Seoul roastery focused on clean, sweet filter coffee from carefully chosen lots.
quote: Clean, sweet filter coffee, chosen lot by lot.

name: Manufact Coffee Roasters
description: Yeonhui-dong roastery with a tiny stand bar and a steady line of well-made blends and single origins.
quote: A tiny Yeonhui-dong stand bar with blends that never miss.

name: Bean Brothers
description: Seoul roaster that helped popularise coffee subscriptions in Korea.
quote: One of the roasters that brought coffee subscriptions to Korean homes.

name: Coffee Temple
description: Specialty roastery and café on Jeju Island.
quote: A reason to plan coffee into your Jeju trip.

name: Felt Coffee
description: Minimalist design meets exceptional roasting. One of Seoul's must-visit specialty destinations.
quote: Seoul's most serene coffee experience. Minimal, considered, exceptional.

name: Counter Culture Coffee
description: Pioneer of direct trade. Their annual transparency report set the industry standard.
quote: The original transparency pioneer. They were doing it before anyone else.

name: Onyx Coffee Lab
description: World Barista Champions. Obsessive attention to sourcing and roast consistency.
quote: World champions who roast like it. Every release is an event.

name: Intelligentsia Coffee
description: Godfather of the third wave. Invented direct trade. Still one of the best.
quote: Without them, specialty coffee looks very different today.

name: Blue Bottle Coffee
description: Global specialty icon with massive presence in Japan. The gateway drug for millions of coffee lovers.
quote: Made specialty coffee mainstream and kept the quality high.

name: Devoción
description: Faster from farm to cup than anyone. They roast Colombian beans within days of harvest.
quote: No one sources Colombian coffee fresher than this. Days from harvest to your cup.

name: Coffee Lab
description: Isabela Raposeiras's legendary lab. Brazil's most respected specialty roaster and coffee educator.
quote: Isabela Raposeiras changed Brazilian coffee. Her lab is the country's gold standard.

name: Ona Coffee
description: World Barista Champion Sasa Sestic's roastery. Australia's finest, ships globally.
quote: Sasa won the World Barista Championship with their coffee. Need more proof?
